risks: First initial many6 workers4 BrokenProcessPool remains unexplained; container removed before extra diagnostics, native child signal and first State.OOMKilled unavailable. Separate successful repro does not establish cause. Four-worker universal safety is not claimed.

Two-worker pool is slower on five of six median measurements. Homog8 preliminary15.7% reduction has one24.3% slower pair and overlapping ranges; three noisy repeats do not establish stable acceptance.
Short four-market jobs pay substantial spawn/import cost (80.3% longer median); default stays serial and pool remains explicit opt-in.
Memory planning allowance can be exceeded by larger workloads; current public profiles do not prove arbitrary workload safety. RSS estimate can double-count shared pages.
Python private executor._processes compatibility requires review on upgrades; direct callers must set BLAS limits before NumPy imports.
ARM64/Rosetta local measurements cannot be extrapolated to official Linux timing; rankable=false.
acceptance_decision: Correctness accepted for measured final workers1/2 modes; general >=15% stable end-to-end acceleration hypothesis not accepted. Only homog8 crosses median threshold preliminarily with unstable pairs. Retain opt-in2 and serial default; no automatic worker optimization claimed.
